title: Single Line Loop Statement
code:
#This is a single line loop statement

for i in range (0,5): print('Current Number is:',i)

lines.code: #This is a single line loop statement
for i in range (0,5): print('Current Number is:',i)
lines.explanation: Entire Forloop can be written in a single line. This is called as the pythonic way of writing a loop. This loop is read as follows: Iterate 'i' from 0 to 4 (less than 5) and print the current number in each iteration
